bugs.title: Lead 'Call' requests CALL_PHONE with an 'SOS calls' rationale, ignores DENY and backgrounds the app when permission is denied
bugs.preconditions: Logged in as Superadmin; phone-call permission never granted to the app; Sales > Leads; lead LD-178
steps: Open Inquiry & Sales > Sales > Leads and search '178'
Tap 'Call' on LD-178
On 'Allow Saagane by Siddaganga to make and manage phone calls?' tap 'Don't allow'
Verify the screen shown (device home screen)
Reopen Saagane from the app drawer (state is preserved) and tap 'Call' again
Read the in-app 'Phone permission' dialog text and tap 'DENY'
Verify that the OS prompt appears again; tap 'Don't allow' and verify the screen
bugs.expected: Call opens the phone dialer pre-filled with the customer's number (no permission needed), or after a denial the user stays on the Leads list with a short message; any rationale refers to calling the customer and DENY closes it
bugs.actual: OS CALL_PHONE prompt on every attempt; after 'Don't allow' the device home screen is shown (2/2); rationale text 'Allow phone access to place SOS calls.'; DENY still opens the OS prompt
bugs.description: Tapping 'Call' on a lead requests the dangerous CALL_PHONE permission (direct calling) instead of opening the dialer. The in-app rationale says the permission is for 'SOS calls', which is wrong for sales. Its DENY button is ignored, and denying the OS prompt sends the app to the background (device home screen). Users who decline lose their place and may believe the app crashed.

bugs.title: Edit Quote: changing vehicle quantity recalculates incorrectly (qty 2 = ₹70,000; back to qty 1 = ₹35,000 instead of ₹37,000)
bugs.preconditions: Quote KLKV914286 (₹37,000: 600 km x ₹55, driver ₹1,000/day, late ₹1,000/day, 2 days)
steps: Open Inquiry & Sales > Sales > Quotes
On 'SpringFive Consulting Services LLP' (KLKV914286, TOTAL ₹37,000) tap ⋮ > Edit Quote
Scroll to Trip-1 > Journey A: OutStation and Vehicle Costs; verify Quantity 1, Driver Allow ₹1,000, Final Quote ₹37,000
Tap '−' on the vehicle stepper - verify it stays at 01 and ₹37,000
Tap '+' (01 → 02) and wait ~5 s for recalculation; read Driver Allow and Final Quote
Tap '−' (02 → 01) and wait ~5 s; read Driver Allow and Final Quote
Tap Cancel at the bottom (do not tap Update Quote)
bugs.expected: Qty 2 total follows the costing rule (e.g. 2 x ₹37,000 = ₹74,000 or as specified); returning to qty 1 restores exactly ₹37,000 with Driver Allow ₹1,000
bugs.actual: Qty 2 → Driver Allow ₹2,000, Final Quote ₹70,000; back to qty 1 → Driver Allow ₹2,000, Final Quote ₹35,000 (≠ original ₹37,000 for identical inputs)

Going from 1 to 2 vehicles gives ₹70,000 (not double ₹37,000), and returning to 1 gives ₹35,000, with Driver Allow left at ₹2,000 instead of the original ₹1,000. A quote can be saved with a wrong total depending on the order of taps.

bugs.title: Lead LD-34 with a 2202-day trip (start 28/11/2020) and ₹4.07 Cr cost was accepted and makes up 93% of the Sales pipeline KPI
bugs.account: Superadmin (QA account from .env, entered by user)
bugs.preconditions: Logged in as Superadmin; Inquiry & Sales > Sales > Leads loaded; lead LD-34 (client 'Amitkumar') exists
bugs.description: The app accepted and stored a lead whose Outstation journey runs from 28/11/2020 to 08/12/2026 (Trip Days 2202), apparently a year typo. partialReason: Interim report - 28 Inquiry & Sales cases await user approvals or business-rule clarifications; no further tests executed for this report.

assumptions.text: Quote vehicle cost formula = Total Kms x Per Km + (Driver Allow + Late Allow) x No. of Days + Toll & Parking + State Tax + Extras + Fixed Cost, with Total Kms = max(actual, Min Km/Day x Days). Verified against 3 saved quotes (₹37,000; ₹60,500; ₹56,000) but not confirmed by a specification.

The lead card 'Email' button was assumed (inventory) to open a mail composer. Actual behaviour is an immediate server-side send; the defect BUG-INQ-01 is about the missing confirmation, not about the send itself.

'Save Assignment' in the New Quote category calendar and 'Add' in Add New Journey were treated as form-level (unsaved) actions; nothing appeared in the Quotes/Inquiries lists afterwards, which supports this.
'Change GST Value > Save' might update the client master record, so it was treated as approval-required (only Cancel exercised).
Test data (leads, quotes, inquiries) is assumed to be QA data on a non-production backend; one customer-facing email was nevertheless sent (see environment notes).

questions.text: How is the Sales 'Conversion Rate' (32.4%, '+5% vs last month') calculated, and should it show a loader until leads load?
Lead status filter offers Active / Closed / Open, but 'Active' returns no leads while the KPI says '172 Active Leads'. What do these statuses mean?
Confirm the quote cost formula (A-01) and how cost should scale with vehicle Quantity (qty 2 gave ₹70,000 vs ₹37,000 for qty 1).
GST (18% / 5%) is shown on the quote but not added to Final Quote, card TOTAL or PDF 'Expected Total'. Should quote totals include GST?
'Client Type' means Regular/Contracted in Inquiries but National/Corporate/International in filters and Lead Details. Which vocabulary is intended for each screen?
Leads with TRANSIT POLICY 'Cancelled' still show status 'Open' and hide the Email button. What is the intended status and action set for cancelled leads?
Are Arrival Time and Departure Time mandatory for a quote (empty on saved quote KLKV914286)?
Is there a maximum vehicle quantity per journey (stepper upper bound)?
May a quote/trip start date be in the past (picker allows it, no warning)?
Are pickup/drop location and times mandatory for a Transfer journey (journey can be added with all N/A)?
GST options are limited to 0%, 5%, 18%. Are 12% and 28% intentionally excluded?
Should the Quotes and Inquiries filters share state (date range set on Quotes is pre-applied on Inquiries)?

Can a dedicated QA lead/quote/inquiry be provided (or created with approval) so that the 19 approval-required cases (Send to Inquiry, Update Quote, Confirm Booking, Generate Quote, Cancel/Delete Inquiry, etc.) can be executed and cleaned up?

Should leads whose TRANSIT POLICY is Cancelled (34 leads, ₹6.2 lakh) and the ₹0 Unassigned lead be counted in the Sales KPI "Active Leads" value/count? (Currently cancelled ones are counted; LD-54 is excluded.)
What is the allowed Number of Pax range, and must the app warn/block when Pax exceeds selected vehicle capacity?

uxFindings.finding: Call and Email trigger immediate, consequential actions (permission prompt / customer email) from a single tap on a list card.
uxFindings.recommendation: Open the dialer with ACTION_DIAL (no CALL_PHONE permission) and show an email preview/confirmation before sending.

uxFindings.finding: View PDF silently downloads to Downloads and shows a native alert; no preview, no download notification, user must find the file in Files.
uxFindings.recommendation: Open the PDF in an in-app viewer or offer 'Open' / 'Share' in the success message.

uxFindings.finding: Close button labelled 'Cancel' sits next to a 'Cancel Inquiry' action; label 'Contracted Client Name' used for regular clients; client type shown in lower case ('regular').
uxFindings.recommendation: Rename the close button to 'Close', use 'Client Name', and use consistent capitalisation.

uxFindings.finding: 'View All' opens the Leads segment but the heading still reads 'Recent Leads'; same for 'Recent Quotes'.
uxFindings.recommendation: Use 'All Leads' / 'All Quotes' for the full lists.

uxFindings.finding: Field accepts '-1.5' and '9999999999' with no inline validation or max length; keypad offers '−' and '.'.
uxFindings.recommendation: Use an integer-only keypad, enforce 1..max and show an inline error.

uxFindings.finding: Cancel discards a long, partly filled form with one tap and no confirmation.
uxFindings.recommendation: Ask 'Discard changes?' when the form is dirty.

uxFindings.finding: Range selection highlights only the start and end dates, not the days in between.
A date range applied on Quotes is silently pre-applied on Inquiries (filter icon active, only 2 of 20 rows).
uxFindings.recommendation: Keep filters per tab or show an 'active filters' chip with a clear action.

uxFindings.finding: Lead search finds IDs, but Quote and Inquiry search do not search PNR/Inquiry ID; placeholder text does not say which fields are searchable.
uxFindings.recommendation: Search name + ID consistently and state it in the placeholder (e.g. 'Search by client or ID').

uxFindings.finding: Edit screen titled 'Add New Quote'; recalculation after stepper taps takes ~3-5 s with only a small spinner on the stepper.
uxFindings.recommendation: Title 'Edit Quote <PNR>' and disable Update Quote while recalculating.
